description: JavaScript library for xajax version 0.2.4, providing AJAX functionalities such as request handling, DOM manipulation, event handling, and response processing.

classes.name: Xajax
classes.description: Main class implementing AJAX request handling, DOM manipulation, and response processing.

methods.name: DebugMessage
methods.description: Outputs debug messages, optionally in a separate window.

methods.name: getRequestObject
methods.description: Creates and returns an XMLHttpRequest object.
Shorthand for document.getElementById, with fallback for older IE.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Dynamically includes an external JavaScript file.

methods.name: stripOnPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'on' prefix from event names.

methods.name: addOnPrefix
methods.description: Adds 'on' prefix to event names.

methods.name: addHandler
methods.description: Adds an event handler to a DOM element.

methods.name: removeHandler
methods.description: Removes an event handler from a DOM element.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and appends a new DOM element under a parent.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new DOM element before a specified sibling.

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts a new DOM element after a specified sibling.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Creates an input element of specified type, name, and id.

methods.name: createInput
methods.description: Creates and appends an input element under a parent.

methods.name: insertInput
methods.description: Inserts an input element before a specified sibling.

methods.name: insertInputAfter
methods.description: Inserts an input element after a specified sibling.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a DOM element by id.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces text within an element's attribute.

methods.name: getFormValues
methods.description: Builds an XML string representing form data.

methods.name: objectToXML
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript object into XML.

methods.name: _nodeToObject
methods.description: Deserializes XML nodes into JavaScript objects.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to invoke a server-side function.

methods.name: getBrowserHTML
methods.description: Retrieves innerHTML as it would appear in the browser.

methods.name: willChange
methods.description: Checks if new data differs from existing DOM content.

methods.name: viewSource
methods.description: Returns the current page's source code.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes XML responses from the server and executes commands.
